description_compelling: A national vote, scheduled or sudden, that puts continued rule of an incumbent regime on the line. Years before the ballot, you'll see media independence, judicial autonomy, and political-rights metrics start to shift. Common in countries oscillating between liberalization and rollback, where the line between a referendum and a regime test is thin.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
